name: multiplayer-agent
description: Make a browser game multiplayer and host it at a share link: rooms, shared real-time state, player identity, saved progress and leaderboards from a hosted backend. No account or key needed to start.

interface.longDescription:
Multiplayer Agent turns a browser game into an online multiplayer game, or builds a new one, without a game server to write or run.

What it does:
- Creates a game and its rooms on a hosted backend. Rooms are created the first time a player joins.
- Writes the client code against the real SDK: each player's state syncs to everyone in the room, plus room-wide state and one-off events.
- Adds player identity, saved progress and leaderboards.
- Deploys server-side game rules so scores and outcomes can't be faked by a player's browser (once the user connects an account).
- Publishes the game to its own share link, so a friend can open it and play.

Who it is for: anyone building a browser game with an AI assistant who wants friends to play together online: casual, co-op, party, .io, turn-based, racing and action games.

How accounts work: no account or key is needed to start. The first tool call opens a temporary studio that lasts 72 hours. To keep the games, the user gives an email and confirms on the website; passwords are never typed in the chat.

Limitations: a game can't run inside the chat preview, so the result is always a share link to open in a browser. All room state is visible to every player in the room unless it is kept in server rules. One huge shared world should be split across rooms.
capabilities: Sync player state in real time
Host the game at a share link
defaultPrompt: Build me a multiplayer snake game I can share with a friend
Add an online leaderboard to my game

positive.description: Build a new multiplayer game from scratch and host it
positive.prompt: Build me a simple multiplayer snake game that I can share with a friend.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a game, writes a single-file HTML client wired to that game's key, publishes it and returns a https://<slug>.play.multiplayeragent.com/ share link that two browsers can open and play together.

positive.description: Make an existing single-player game multiplayer
positive.prompt:
Here is my single-player pong game in one HTML file. Make it two-player online and give me a link.

<!doctype html><canvas id=c width=400 height=300></canvas><script>const x=c.getContext('2d');let p=120,b={x:200,y:150,dx:3,dy:2};onmousemove=e=>p=e.offsetY-30;(function f(){b.x+=b.dx;b.y+=b.dy;if(b.y<0||b.y>300)b.dy*=-1;if(b.x<10&&b.y>p&&b.y<p+60||b.x>390)b.dx*=-1;x.clearRect(0,0,400,300);x.fillRect(0,p,8,60);x.fillRect(b.x,b.y,6,6);requestAnimationFrame(f)})()</script>
positive.expected_behavior: Keeps the existing game logic, adds a second remote paddle synced through the room, publishes the result and returns a share link.

positive.prompt: Build a multiplayer clicker game with an online leaderboard and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Builds the game with a leaderboard using the SDK reference, publishes it and returns a share link; the leaderboard shows scores from different players.

positive.prompt: What multiplayer starter games can I begin from?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists available starter games by genre with short descriptions and offers to start from one.

positive.description: Save games to the user's own account without a password in chat
positive.prompt: I want to keep the games we made. Save them to my account, my email is reviewer@multiplayeragent.com
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a one-time link and a short code, tells the user to open the link, sign in on the website and press Connect after checking the code. Never asks for a password.

negative.description: Unrelated coding task. The plugin should not act: nothing about games or multiplayer is involved.
negative.prompt: Write a Python script that sorts a CSV file by its second column.

negative.description: General game recommendation, not a build request. The plugin should not act; answer normally without creating anything.
negative.prompt: What are some good single-player puzzle games on Steam?

negative.description: User offers a password in chat. The plugin must not use it or call any tool with it; it should explain that passwords are only typed on the website and offer the connect link instead.
negative.prompt: Log me into my Multiplayer Agent account, my password is hunter2
